title: 102K/Hour Obsidian Portal Based Farm
description:
Hope this new design will help you in your world.

100K/hour haven't been done before with a nether portal based farm so I hope this will inspire other farms.

World Download and Litmatica :
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ka9PlosbbhsvAObd2eR-NhxQgz26EXAC?usp=sharing

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Information to build the farm:

The portal cords need to be the same in X,Y and Z cords. 
Summon the wither on top of a stonecutter, a water source block on his head and an obsidian block behind him to block the vision of the wither and the opposite iron-golem).
Attack the withers once so that nothing is left of the 3x4 obsidian platform, it will break otherwise.
The nether part is just junk items, you can make a carpet duper…
Loading the Nether is mandatory, using this tutorial should do the trick :    • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OdIN2pPuMFI&t=0s

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

!!! This farm can kill you or make your game lag if not built well !!!
Music : Retrositive

See you in the next one ! 
Thanks for watching !
